title: The Small Aftermath
author: Gideon Brightwater
blurb: Marguerite Zhou, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
